row.title: The one-year unattended target is a measured runway
row.body: RUNWAY-1: target_days in doctrine/runway.json is measured every watchdog run from credentials, cost and unrepaired failures; an unmeasured component is below target. The cost probe reads the account id from doctrine/cost.json so the runner measures instead of recording unmeasured. Workers Logs are enabled in every deploy's metadata.

title: The one-year unattended target is a measured runway
